esp32.detail: 3 pins wired; YF-S401 water flow sensor (hall-effect, pulse output) needs at least 4.5 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.OUT → D25 (GPIO25). Added a 10 kΩ / 20 kΩ divider on OUT: it swings to 5 V, and the D25 pin takes 3.3 V at most. Added the yfs401.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the flow rate set on the slider: passes

Reports the flow rate set on the slider: passes
